fullContentHtml:
NTPC NSPCL Various Post Online Form 2026 – Full Details

NTPC Sail Power Company Limited (NSPCL) has released the notification for the post of Sr. Assistant Officer / Sr. Assistant Engineer In HR / Law/ Electrical / Mechanical / C&I / IT In E1 Grade. This recruitment has been issued for 16 posts. The online application process for NTPC NSPCL Various Post Recruitment 2026 will start from 07 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 22 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NTPC NSPCL Various Post Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 September 2026
  • Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
